# Jay Farfan

> Portfolio of Jay Farfan, Senior Product Designer & UX/UI Designer combining strategy, human judgment and AI to craft simple, scalable digital products.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Selected work, process, skillset and contact.
- [About](/about): Background, principles and how Jay works.

## Case studies

- [MINSA / Digital Humans](/work/minsa): Redesign of Peru's Ministry of Health COVID-19 app for accessibility and clarity.
- [Certezia](/work/certezia): Optimizing a high-friction digital signing flow with NFC interaction.
- [Komu AI](/work/komu-ai): Designing a WhatsApp AI financial assistant and its product ecosystem.
- [Karway](/work/karway): Product vision for an automotive marketplace.
- [KindBerry](/work/kindberry): Premium children's clothing e-commerce experience.
